terms.definition: Variation in latency, token use, API spend, or duration across repeated identical requests.
terms.scopeNote: Implements resource consistency as a measurable quantity.
terms.literatureNote: Quantifiers attached to dimensions — not synonyms for accuracy or reliability. Academic metric names appear in academicTerms only.

terms.definition: How much of an allowed retry, re-query, or re-plan budget a task consumes before success, escalation, or failure.
terms.scopeNote: Links correction mechanisms to cost and recovery failure risk.
